title: Armchairs
lead: Tub and barrel chairs, wingbacks, bouclé lounge chairs and chairs framed in wood or metal.
intro: Every chair has a number, like Armchair No. 12. Ask about it by number and we will come back with sizes, finishes, pricing and lead time.
